purpose: Illustrative semantic image/caption check, not POS trace or random sample

captions: A young man riding on the back of a white horse.
A small boy riding a very pretty small horse by some people.
No one standing next to the boy well he is riding the pony.
A young boy riding bareback on a horse at a fair
examples.selected_caption: A young boy riding bareback on a horse at a fair

assistant_visual_assessment.observation: Boy is visibly seated astride a pony/horse holding reins; riding is appropriate. Motion itself cannot be inferred from a still image.

captions: a number of people riding bicycles on a street
People are riding bikes down a street with a tree.
People riding bikes in the street with mopeds parked on the sidewalk.
Two adults and a child riding bicycles on a city street
examples.selected_caption: a number of people riding bicycles on a street

assistant_visual_assessment.observation: People are astride bicycles at a street crossing; ride is appropriate, but active pedaling/motion is not established by the frame.

captions: A group of women riding on the back of a motorcycle.
examples.selected_caption: A group of women riding on the back of a motorcycle.

assistant_visual_assessment.observation: Three people pose beside/on a stationary motorcycle; the central person may be astride it, but the image does not support the entire group riding on its back.

selection: Three purposive locally available TRAIN images, horse/bicycle/motorcycle; not a random/representative sample
conclusion: Two riding captions visually plausible; group-riding motorcycle caption not supported. Does not establish token-to-lemma mapping or an error rate for the dataset.
